summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Home #security section (reference-faithful lavender stage) at 1440x900 and 390x844. All required elements render: badge, CinematicText heading (fully visible), subtitle, 4 compliance badges (GDPR/HIPAA/DPDP/CCPA), hub diagram with 4 source pills (Google Ads/Meta Ads left, GA4/TikTok Ads right), black Fluxvex core pill centered, SVG wires + vertical drop arrow, 5 SMIL animateMotion packet circles present in DOM. Three tinted cards (security-tinted-scope/encryption/control) render with inline chips (read-only/encrypted/revocable) and their mini-UIs. Links work: security-approach-link -> /security loads fully, security-policy-link -> /privacy-policy loads. Mobile stacked flow shows 2 ArrowDown icons between Google/Meta -> Fluxvex -> GA4/TikTok. No horizontal overflow at either breakpoint (scrollWidth == innerWidth). Zero substantive console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SecuritySection.jsx (420 lines) is approaching the recommended 700-line soft limit; still well within budget but worth watching if more card variants are added.

Inline template literal in TintedCard uses `transparent_1px` with an underscore inside the gradient string (line 171-172) — browser is lenient but it's technically malformed CSS (should be `transparent 1px`). The checker grid still renders due to the second gradient; consider cleaning up for correctness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home #security section + /security + /privacy-policy regression all pass as of iteration 29. SMIL packet motion was verified by DOM presence (5 animateMotion elements) per instructions — snapshot-based position diff showed identical coords in short interval, which is expected since SMIL is paused/synchronous between JS ticks; do not treat that as a bug.
